name: smb-erp
description: On-premises ERP desktop and application server

scripts.build: npm run build -w @erp/contracts && npm run build -w @erp/server && npm run build -w @erp/desktop
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @erp/contracts && npm run build -w @erp/server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @erp/contracts && npm run build -w @erp/desktop
scripts.check: npm run build -w @erp/contracts && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:setup: npm run build:server && node apps/server/dist/database/cli.js setup
scripts.package:windows: npm run build:desktop && npm run package:windows -w @erp/desktop
